messages:
pagerduty-bot: [PD] Page fired: INCIDENT #INC-2026-412 inference-prod-high-latency (severity: 2) — p50 2.3s, p95 4.7s, p99 8.4s. Increased request timeouts observed on hosted API routes. Pager: maya (oncall)

maya: ack. i'm on it — starting a quick triage. pinging rotation.

pagerbot: maya has acknowledged the page. Escalation timer paused.

lucas: i'm nearby if you want a second pair of eyes. any recent deploys?

maya: deploy-bot shows no deploys in the last 40m. checking infra and metrics now.

maya: quick checks — node CPU/RAM look normal. hitting the internal metrics endpoint to see queue depth: `GET /internal/metrics?service=inference`

maya: seeing a spike in request_queue_depth on inference-pool-a and many KV cache misses. p50 per-request queueing up.

incident-bot: auto-escalated to secondary oncall after 2m of no resolution. Notifying orpheus.

orpheus: ack and stepping in. maya, can you paste a couple of example request ids (the ones that timed out)?

maya: example request ids: req_5f8a1c9d, req_5f8a1d02. logs from model-worker (truncated):

```
2026-07-11T12:07:14Z model-worker[pid=4321] WARN KVCache miss: key=model:v1:kv:abcd
2026-07-11T12:07:14Z model-worker[pid=4321] INFO fallback to cold-start kernel
2026-07-11T12:07:15Z model-worker[pid=4321] ERROR inference latency=3120ms request_id=req_5f8a1c9d
```

lucas: KV cache miss waterfall could explain extra 2-6s per request if many tokens require cold path. network looks ok.

orpheus: i'm going to check model-serving pool health and cache evictions. probable root cause: cache TTL too low after recent config tweak.

maya: lucas — can you prepare a rolling restart of inference-pool-a canary (2 pods) so we can validate cache warms? i'll coordinate traffic.

lucas: initiating canary restart now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-pool-a -n prod --selector=canary=true`

deploy-bot: rollout triggered for deployment/inference-pool-a (namespace=prod). 2 pods restarting (canary).

lucas: canary pods came up healthy. initial p95 for canary routes down from 4.7s -> 880ms after cache warmup (~30s).

maya: observed global p95 drop to ~1.1s for the next 2m window. request timeouts stopped. No customer 5xx spikes.

orpheus: confirmed logs show significantly fewer KVCache misses after restart. looks like cache TTL was set to 1s due to a bad config flip earlier today. reverting to 300s on cache config and rolling restarts for remaining replica sets.

orpheus: reverting config: `kubectl set env deployment/model-worker CACHE_TTL=300 -n prod` and then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-worker -n prod` (doing phased rollouts).

maya: i'm handing off ongoing monitoring and post-incident tracking to @orpheus. i'll update the PD incident and mark immediate mitigation as completed.

orpheus: ack handoff, taking ownership for follow-ups and postmortem. will keep a 30m watch on p99 and error budget alerts. creating incident note + linking to #incidents.

maya: thanks everyone for the quick help :thumbsup: — reopening the channel if anything regresses.

deploy-bot: Incident note created: https://redwood-pd/incidents/INC-2026-412 (owner: orpheus)

pagerbot: page resolved (ack + mitigation applied).
